Donkey Kong.name: Donkey Kong
Donkey Kong.summary: Donkey Kong is a Game Boy game which starts out with the premise of being a straight remake of the original Donkey Kong arcade game. Although at first it appears to be just a port, the familiar levels from the arcade game are just a prelude to the real platform jumping adventure. There are 97 levels spread out over 9 worlds. These levels are much more complex than the originals, featuring scrolling backgrounds, numerous objects to collect, and enemies to avoid. Along the way, you will encounter several boss style battles with Donkey Kong, as well. When played on a Super Game Boy, the game is colorized, digitized speech is added and the ending music takes advantage of the SNES sound chip.

SD Gundam - SD Sengokuden - Kunitori Mon.summary: Strategy video game published by Bandai in 1990, for the Game Boy.

Skate or Die - Bad 'N Rad.name: Skate or Die: Bad 'N Rad
Skate or Die - Bad 'N Rad.summary: Skate Or Die: Bad'N Rad is a Jump'N Run that consists of 7 levels, three of which are viewed from a top-down perspective. The side-scrolling levels play similarly to other Jump'N Runs, as players have to avoid obstacles and kill enemies by jumping on them. However, since they are on a skateboard, speed is important, so players cannot stop immediately and sometimes need to ride at full speed to clear wider jumps. The top-down levels play more similarly to other Skate Or Die games, as gradients influence players' driving while they are trying to avoid obstacles, enemies, and deadly spikes.
